jobs.title: Founding Machine Learning Engineer ($220k-$280k + Equity) at Glauc
jobs.description:
This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.

She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.

The next step is to speak to Jack.

Job Title

Founding Machine Learning Engineer

Salary

$220k-$280k + Equity

Company Description

Glauc is a technical healthcare startup building a biological health measurement layer using smartphone eye imaging, supported by a proprietary dataset from Harvard-affiliated researchers at Mass Eye and Ear.

Job Description

As the founding ML engineer at Glauc, you will own the core science and technical direction for extracting biological signals from eye images. You will build and deploy production-grade models from scratch using a unique research dataset, transforming clinical insights into a commercial API product for longevity and health-AI companies.

Location

San Francisco, USA

Why this role is remarkable

Access a proprietary dataset developed with Harvard-affiliated researchers at Mass Eye and Ear that provides a data advantage most of the field cannot access.
Join as the first ML hire with a clear trajectory to Head of ML as the company scales following its current funding rounds.
Solve a massive healthcare problem by making biological measurement as accessible as a phone camera, moving the industry from reactive to proactive care.

What You Will Do

Own the end-to-end ML pipeline, from data curation and model architecture to training and deploying production-ready computer vision models for biomarker prediction.
Design rigorous, leakage-free validation frameworks to ensure clinical credibility and model generalization across diverse devices, capture conditions, and populations.
Establish the engineering foundations for the ML organization, including experiment tracking, reproducibility, and monitoring standards that all future hires will inherit.

The ideal candidate

Has a strong applied ML background in computer vision, specifically with image models or medical imaging, and deep fluency in Python and PyTorch.
Brings a proven track record of shipping ML models into fast-scaling production systems that real-world users and commercial customers depend on.
Demonstrates high technical rigor and the ability to thrive in an ambiguous, ground-floor startup environment where you will set precedents rather than follow them.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

Intellectual curiosity and an interest in applying ML advances to difficult quantitative problems.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

At Warner Music Group, our Strategic Finance team serves as the analytical engine that drives both our high-level business strategy and day-to-day operations. By extracting actionable intelligence from core financial data, the team partners seamlessly across Warner Music’s Central Functions, Recorded Music, and Music Publishing to uncover deep business insights. Ultimately, Strategic Finance sits at the forefront of the company, mapping the financial dynamics and emerging trends that are actively shaping the future of the global music industry.

Your role:

As the Data Scientist for Strategic Finance, you will act as the crucial link between our financial strategists and the Technology department. A key part of your mission is collaborating closely with the technology engineers and data scientists who are building our state-of-the-art predictive forecasting platform, ensuring the tool perfectly aligns with business needs. Alongside this, you will deploy modern AI solutions to automate complex financial workflows and transform ambiguous, disparate data into standardized, cohesive datasets—moving the department away from fragile legacy spreadsheets and toward a highly automated, self-service data ecosystem.

Here you’ll get to:

Partner closely with Technology and Affiliate Finance teams to gather requirements, design, and deploy a robust financial forecasting and planning tool that supports WMG's long-term modeling.
Spearhead AI and automation initiatives to eliminate manual bottlenecks and streamline workflows across Strategic Finance.
Enforce data integrity within Strategic Finance by collaborating with data management teams to architect datasets and automate rigorous quality controls.
Work directly with senior finance collaborators to clarify complex problems and build the right analytical or technology-based approaches using large, dynamic datasets.
Act as the trusted liaison between Strategic Finance, Technology, and data platform collaborators to ensure all technical solutions perfectly align with business priorities.

About you:

Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
3-5 years of hands-on, practical experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), Python-based automation, internal app frameworks (Streamlit), BI/reporting tools, workflow automation platforms (Airtable), and AI-assisted development tools.
Experience helping teams adopt new tools, new processes, and more modern ways of working while staying grounded in business realities.
Demonstrated ability to lead and implement data science projects with minimal supervision.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and model development.
Experience with machine learning frameworks and statistical tools.
Strong understanding of SQL and working with large datasets.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical collaborators.
Strong problem-solving abilities, with a bias towards action and a proactive approach to finding opportunities and challenges.

We’d love it if you also had:

Familiarity with the streaming music landscape or other digital media
Experience in finance transformation and EPM implementation
Knowledge of accounting concepts and revenue recognition principles

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. Salary Range: $130,000 - $150,000 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as work experience and business needs. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Moxo is an AI workflow automation platform that powers complex, multi-step business processes by orchestrating work between humans and AI agents. Its AI agents manage operational tasks such as preparing documents, validating submissions, extracting data, routing work, and tracking overdue items, while people focus on judgment-based decisions and approvals.

Teams can design workflows in plain language and build self-learning AI agents with Agent Foundry or integrate their own, enabling robust flows that handle branches, exceptions, and escalations. Internal teams, clients, vendors, and partners collaborate through branded, account-free portals, allowing processes like client onboarding and vendor compliance to run end-to-end without delays.

The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
is a full-time role based in New York City, New York
.
You’ll work directly with prospects & customers to understand how their business operates, identify where Moxo can make a meaningful difference, and turn those ideas into working processes.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery
. One day you might be mapping a complex business process with a customer, the next configuring a workflow, building an integration, working with APIs, or helping launch a new AI-powered use case.

You won’t simply hand requirements back to another team. You’ll stay close to the problem, build alongside the customer, and help make sure what we deliver actually achieves the business outcome they came to Moxo for.

What we’re looking for
Build things that work in the real world.
You have strong software engineering fundamentals and are comfortable designing, building, debugging, and shipping production-ready solutions.
Love working with customers.
You’re comfortable getting into a room with business and technical stakeholders, asking the right questions, and turning an ambiguous problem into something concrete.
Own the outcome.
You don’t think your job ends when something is configured or deployed. You stay involved through testing, launch, adoption, and iteration to make sure the customer succeeds.
Connect systems together.
You’re comfortable working with APIs, integrations, data, authentication, and the enterprise systems that sit around a customer’s workflow.
Turn complexity into something simple.
You can take a messy business process, understand what really matters, and design a solution that customers can actually use.
Move comfortably between technical and business conversations.
You can go deep with an engineering team and then explain the same solution clearly to a business leader.
Learn quickly and share what you learn.
Forward Deployed Engineering means encountering new industries, systems, and problems constantly. You’ll help document patterns, share lessons with the wider team, and make the next deployment better than the last.
Stay close to what’s happening in AI.
Take a genuine interest in new developments across AI and applied AI, and keep learning so you can bring fresh ideas and informed guidance to our customers.
Look for where Moxo can help next.
Whether you’re working inside an existing customer or meeting people at an industry event, stay curious about other problems Moxo could solve and help turn those opportunities into action.
Bring 4–6 years of relevant experience.
You have a strong foundation in software engineering, customer-facing technical work, or building and deploying solutions.
Travel as needed.
This role includes regular customer travel. While we plan ahead whenever possible, customer needs can move quickly, and occasionally travel may come together on short notice.
Help the team ramp.
As the team grows, you may occasionally help newer team members get up to speed by sharing context, experience, and what’s working in the field.

jobs.description:
Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

We're hiring a hands-on Solution Architect who will design and evolve both the high-level and detailed architecture for new product features while supporting and improving existing capabilities. You'll lead with code and architecture-pairing with engineers, producing reference implementations, and ensuring robust, scalable, cost-efficient solutions in Azure using .NET/C#, React/Node/TypeScript, and modern data-processing patterns.

Primary Responsibilities:

Define HLD/LLD for new features and complex refactors (context & container diagrams, sequence diagrams, deployment views, data flows).
Author and steward Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), validate decisions via experiments and load tests.
Build reference implementations/PoCs in C#/.NET and React/Node to de-risk patterns, performance, and operability.
Review and merge PRs, provide actionable feedback, and pair with engineers on tricky problems.
Design event-driven and streaming architectures leveraging Azure Service Bus, Functions, App Services, AKS, and API Management.
Engineer for high throughput and low latency: concurrency, async I/O, caching (Redis), partitioning, idempotency, back-pressure, and circuit-breaking.

This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.

She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.

The next step is to speak to Jack.

Job Title

Founding Machine Learning Engineer

Salary

$220k-$280k + Equity

Company Description

Glauc is a technical healthcare startup building a biological health measurement layer using smartphone eye imaging, supported by a proprietary dataset from Harvard-affiliated researchers at Mass Eye and Ear.

Job Description

As the founding ML engineer at Glauc, you will own the core science and technical direction for extracting biological signals from eye images. You will build and deploy production-grade models from scratch using a unique research dataset, transforming clinical insights into a commercial API product for longevity and health-AI companies.

Location

San Francisco, USA

Why this role is remarkable

Access a proprietary dataset developed with Harvard-affiliated researchers at Mass Eye and Ear that provides a data advantage most of the field cannot access.
Join as the first ML hire with a clear trajectory to Head of ML as the company scales following its current funding rounds.
Solve a massive healthcare problem by making biological measurement as accessible as a phone camera, moving the industry from reactive to proactive care.

What You Will Do

Own the end-to-end ML pipeline, from data curation and model architecture to training and deploying production-ready computer vision models for biomarker prediction.
Design rigorous, leakage-free validation frameworks to ensure clinical credibility and model generalization across diverse devices, capture conditions, and populations.
Establish the engineering foundations for the ML organization, including experiment tracking, reproducibility, and monitoring standards that all future hires will inherit.

The ideal candidate

Has a strong applied ML background in computer vision, specifically with image models or medical imaging, and deep fluency in Python and PyTorch.
Brings a proven track record of shipping ML models into fast-scaling production systems that real-world users and commercial customers depend on.
Demonstrates high technical rigor and the ability to thrive in an ambiguous, ground-floor startup environment where you will set precedents rather than follow them.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

.

Photos Storytelling is on a mission to help 1.5 billion+ Photos users craft, experience, and share their life's stories using the world's most advanced AI. We partner directly with GDM to deploy the latest GenMedia models and are actively building agentic features that allow users to deeply reminisce and share their most meaningful moments.

In this role, you will lead our team's efforts to develop and ship agentic Storytelling experiences, working across our Memories and Video Editing teams to help redefine our app for the future. This is a rare, high visibility opportunity to define how AI-native storytelling works at Google scale.

Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client-side (web and mobile), with server-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. We are dedicated to making Google experiences centered around the user.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Responsibilities

Define the multi-year technical goal and scalable architecture for agentic storytelling in Photos. Lead the technical strategy connecting curation, retrieval, and story generation systems with the Photos in-app agent and Gemini.
Architect and develop conversational and agentic capabilities that leverage GenMedia and the latest LLMs to help users reminisce, curate, and create stories. Establish best practices for agentic systems, focusing on multi-turn orchestration, model evaluation, inference latency, and technical design at massive scale.
Partner with engineering leads across Photos to build unified curation, retrieval, and editing capabilities, and work closely with research partners to integrate the latest generative models.
Pioneer the use of AI to accelerate development; coach the team on agentic workflows and emerging practices to multiply engineering output and impact.

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

We're hiring a hands-on Solution Architect who will design and evolve both the high-level and detailed architecture for new product features while supporting and improving existing capabilities. You'll lead with code and architecture-pairing with engineers, producing reference implementations, and ensuring robust, scalable, cost-efficient solutions in Azure using .NET/C#, React/Node/TypeScript, and modern data-processing patterns.

Primary Responsibilities:

Define HLD/LLD for new features and complex refactors (context & container diagrams, sequence diagrams, deployment views, data flows).
Author and steward Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), validate decisions via experiments and load tests.
Build reference implementations/PoCs in C#/.NET and React/Node to de-risk patterns, performance, and operability.
Review and merge PRs, provide actionable feedback, and pair with engineers on tricky problems.
Design event-driven and streaming architectures leveraging Azure Service Bus, Functions, App Services, AKS, and API Management.
Engineer for high throughput and low latency: concurrency, async I/O, caching (Redis), partitioning, idempotency, back-pressure, and circuit-breaking.
Model data across Azure SQL and Cosmos DB, including indexing, partitioning, consistency, and query optimization.
Guide modern React (TypeScript) architecture: component design, state management, performance profiling, accessibility, SSR/BFF patterns with Node.js.
Ensure clean API contracts (REST/JSON, GraphQL where appropriate), schema governance, and sound error semantics.
Drive observability: distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), metrics and logs (App Insights), and actionable dashboards/alerts.
Bake in security: OIDC/OAuth2 (Entra ID), secrets management (Key Vault), OWASP ASVS, threat modeling.
Define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and ensure production readiness-on-call participation and RCA for major incidents.
Champion CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), IaC (Bicep/Terraform), repeatable environments, and golden paths/templates.
Optimize for cost and performance (FinOps): right-sizing compute, data tiering, caching, and workload scheduling

While this position is posted in the US, we can only accept applications from those performing aDeloitte Global (DTTS) role at this time.

The team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Qualifications

Required:

At least 7 years experience building production software, 3+ years as a hands-on architect or principal engineer.
Deep proficiency in C#/.NET (7/8), ASP.NET Core, WebAPI, async/concurrency, performance profiling.
Strong React (18+) + TypeScript and Node.js experience, testing with Jest/Cypress.
Azure expertise: App Services, Functions, AKS, API Management, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Storage, Key Vault, App Insights.
Proven delivery of data-processing-intensive systems (batch/stream, resiliency, throughput, cost).
CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions), IaC (Bicep/Terraform), containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
Solid understanding of architecture trade-offs, DDD, integration patterns, and secure design.

Preferred:

Experience with Databricks / Data Lake, Tableau or PowerBI.
Multi-region active-active design, disaster recovery (RPO/RTO), OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL.
Certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert.

Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
